overview: Manzano is a unified multimodal LLM that harmonizes image understanding and generation through a hybrid vision tokenizer (shared ViT encoder with continuous adapter for understanding and discrete adapter for generation), a unified autoregressive LLM decoder, and a diffusion-based image decoder, trained via a three-stage recipe to achieve SOTA results with minimal task conflict.

modules.name: Hybrid Image Tokenizer
modules.description: Implements the core hybrid vision tokenizer consisting of a shared ViT backbone feeding two lightweight specialized adapters. The continuous adapter produces embeddings for image understanding (I2T) and the discrete adapter produces quantized tokens for image generation (T2I), both inhabiting a common semantic space to mitigate task conflict. Includes forward propagation for both adapter paths and shared parameter management.

modules.name: Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ) Module
modules.description: Implements the FSQ quantization technique used in the discrete adapter path. Supports large codebook sizes (e.g., 64K) with finite scalar quantization instead of traditional VQ-VAE lookup, providing simplicity and scalability. Includes the quantization, dequantization, and straight-through gradient estimation operations needed for end-to-end training.

modules.name: Spatial-to-Channel (STC) Compression Layer
modules.description: Implements the 3×3 spatial-to-channel transformation that reduces the number of spatial tokens by a factor of 9 (e.g., from 42×42×1024 to 14×14×9216). This compression step is shared by both the continuous and discrete adapter paths before their respective projection/quantization stages.

modules.name: Unified Autoregressive LLM Decoder
modules.description: Implements the unified LLM decoder that jointly processes text tokens, continuous image embeddings (for understanding), and discrete image tokens (for generation) using a single autoregressive next-token prediction objective over a joint vocabulary. Handles the interleaving of different token types within sequences and supports variable-size model configurations from 300M to 30B parameters.

modules.name: DiT-Air Image Decoder with Flow Matching
modules.description: Implements the diffusion-based image decoder using the DiT-Air architecture with layer-wise parameter sharing for efficiency. Takes discrete image tokens generated by the LLM as conditioning signals and uses a conditional flow matching objective to transport Gaussian noise into realistic images. Supports multiple decoder configurations (0.9B, 1.75B, 3.52B) and output resolutions from 256 to 2048 pixels.

modules.name: Data Preprocessing and Tokenization Pipeline
modules.description: Implements the complete data preprocessing pipeline covering text tokenization, image transformation (resizing, normalization), and dual-path image tokenization (continuous embedding extraction for understanding and discrete token extraction for generation). Handles format conversion for pure text, interleaved image-text, image-to-text, and text-to-image data modalities.

modules.name: Mixed-Modality Data Loader and Sampler
modules.description: Implements custom dataset and DataLoader classes for sampling mixed batches containing text-only, interleaved image-text, image-to-text (IT), and text-to-image (TI) examples. Manages batch-level token type interleaving, dynamic padding strategies for heterogeneous token sequences, and balanced sampling across modalities to support stable joint training.

modules.name: Tokenizer Pre-alignment Training
modules.description: Implements the initial pre-training stage for the hybrid tokenizer using a small 300M LLM decoder to pre-align image features with the LLM feature space. Includes the random sampling mechanism between continuous and discrete adapter outputs during training, and the alignment loss computation for both token types.

modules.name: Three-Stage Unified Training Workflow
modules.description: Implements the complete training controller managing all three stages: (1) large-scale pre-training on text-only, interleaved, IT, and TI data for broad cross-modal alignment; (2) continued pre-training on higher-quality curated IT and TI data for domain-specific capabilities (documents, charts); (3) supervised fine-tuning on curated instruction data for instruction following. Manages stage transitions, data mixture adjustments, and stage-specific hyperparameters.

modules.name: Inference Pipeline
modules.description: Implements the dual-path inference pipeline. For understanding tasks, processes input images through the continuous adapter path and feeds combined features to the LLM for text answer prediction. For generation tasks, takes text input, autoregressively predicts image token sequences via the LLM, and renders pixels through the diffusion decoder. Supports beam search, temperature sampling, and top-k/top-p decoding strategies.

modules.name: Image Understanding Evaluation Suite
modules.description: Implements evaluation on three categories of understanding benchmarks: (i) General VQA (SeedBench, RealWorldQA, MMBench), (ii) Knowledge & Reasoning (AI2D, ScienceQA, MMMU, MathVista), and (iii) Text-rich Document & Chart Understanding (ChartQA, TextVQA, DocVQA, InfoVQA, OCRBench). Computes accuracy-based metrics across all benchmarks with standardized prompt templates and answer extraction.

modules.name: Image Generation Automated Evaluation
modules.description: Implements automated generation evaluation on GenEval (object-focused text-to-image alignment with single/two object, counting, colors, position, color attributes), DPGBench (prompt following generation), and WISE (world-knowledge-informed semantic evaluation across cultural, time, space, biology, physics, chemistry dimensions). Includes prompt formatting, image generation, and metric computation pipelines.

modules.name: Human Evaluation Framework
modules.description: Implements the human evaluation protocol for image generation quality assessment. Manages the 800-challenge-prompt evaluation set, three-dimension rating (structural integrity, instruction following, aesthetic quality) with three-grade scoring (major/minor/no issues), bias mitigation via entity masking and sample order randomization, and score aggregation across three independent raters per sample.

modules.name: Tokenizer Strategy and Task Conflict Ablation
modules.description: Implements ablation experiments comparing three tokenizer paradigms: (i) pure-discrete (same discrete tokens for both tasks), (ii) dual-encoder (separate semantic encoder for understanding and VAE-style encoder for generation), and (iii) hybrid tokenizer (proposed). Also implements unified vs. single-task training comparisons with controlled training steps and token exposure, quantifying task conflict across understanding and generation benchmarks.

modules.name: Model Scaling Analysis Framework
modules.description: Implements experiments for analyzing scaling behavior along two dimensions: (i) LLM decoder scaling (300M, 1B, 3B, 30B) with fixed image decoder and hyperparameters, and (ii) image decoder scaling (0.9B, 1.75B, 3.52B) with fixed LLM decoder. Tracks monotonic gains across all understanding and generation metrics, and reports human evaluation scores for structural integrity, instruction following, and aesthetic quality at each scale.

modules.name: Image Editing Extension Module
modules.description: Implements the image editing capability extension by jointly conditioning both the LLM and the diffusion decoder on a reference image. The LLM handles instruction following and semantic coherence while the diffusion decoder enforces pixel-level control. Supports instruction-guided editing, style transfer, inpainting, outpainting, and depth estimation tasks through unified conditioning mechanisms.
